Introduction: Well, hello there... New in town, are we? Pennywise. Don't forget my name. Hee hee.$u
Mon: The sewers are full of secrets. Some of them have teeth.$u
Tue: People say this town is peaceful. People are very easy to fool.$u
Wed: Do you like balloons? They make such lovely little markers...$u
Thu: I saw you walking alone. You should be more careful.$u
Fri: The lights go out early down here. That's when the fun begins.$u
Sat: Come closer. I promise I only bite when I'm hungry.$u
Sun: Such a cheerful little town. It almost makes me sick.$u
Rainy_Day_0: Rain washes away footprints. Not memories.$u
Rainy_Day_1: Listen to the drains. Sometimes they whisper back.$u
fall: The air is getting colder. I do love this time of year.$u
winter: Snow covers everything... even the things underneath.$u
